sources.title: CS329A: Self-Improving AI Agents — Autumn 2025
sources.attribution: Stanford graduate research seminar taught by Aakanksha Chowdhery and Azalia Mirhoseini. Public syllabus and reading links cover verification, test-time compute, reinforcement learning, tools, memory and long-horizon evaluation. This reference is not enrollment, certification or an independently completed research project; the course does not allow audits.
